ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $\triangle ABC \cong \triangle DEF$, $BE=5$, $BF=1$, what is the length of $CF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $BE=5$, and $BF=1$,\\
it follows that $EF=BE-BF=4$,\\
Since $\triangle ABC \cong \triangle DEF$,\\
it follows that $BC=EF=4$,\\
Therefore, $CF=BC-BF=4-1=\boxed{3}$.
